milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the lectern (placed at spawn-relative [5, 1, 6] inside the library building) and face toward it, modeling that the player can visually observe the target. max_distance=5 requires the player to be inside or at the entrance of the small library (interior is ~5x5 blocks), ensuring they have actually 'found' the block rather than just being in the general area. facing_tolerance=60° confirms the player is looking toward the lectern. The milestone is NOT pre-satisfied at spawn since the distance from (0,0,0) to (5,1,6) ≈ 7.87 blocks exceeds max_distance of 5.
